**@aaronjmars**  
Full text: picked the model: Qwen3.5-9B on tinker. small enough to iterate quickly for single digit dollars, big enough to pick up real style.  

fine-tuned not just for agents that "write a tweet," bc they act, create_post, quote_post, like, follow. real tool calls on miroshark. base model dont speak that format, so it's the instruct version + a lora on top. keep the tool-calling system, retrain the voice.  

then data, pulled ~11 accounts i actually respect here & filtered down to ~9k originals. curation > volume, always.  

reframed every tweet into an action. persona card in → create_post out, in miroshark's exact prompt format. so the model learns the actual skill - given who you are, post like a human, not like an assistant that read your wikipedia page.  

also killed preamble & balanced the accounts so no single voice eats the blend.  

SFT (supervised fine-tuning) training launched, next up: DPO  

specs:  
- lora (rank 32) supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.5-9B instruct with the qwen3_5_disable_thinking renderer.  
- given a persona + feed, emit a native create_post tool-call whose content reads like a real human - trained on 4,041 real tweets reframed as create_post actions, 1 epoch, LR 4.73e-4.  
- we only train on the action (the tool-call), not the prompt.
